example.title: Rider-Lewis Motor Car Company, West Second Street & Sycamore

brief: Early motor-car factory of 1909: a two-storey limestone-trimmed brick office with a corniced front, and behind it long one-storey white-painted brick assembly sheds with monitor roofs, one end-gabled with a stepped parapet.

components: long one-storey assembly sheds with roof monitors
